### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What**: the decisions every rank must take identically (the time step, a redo, stopping on a signal) are reduced
over all processes with small CPU tensors. **Switch**: none. **Default**: on whenever there is more than one
process. **Requires**: a process group. **Order**: exact for MIN and MAX. **Defining equation**: none.
:::

| decision | reduction | tensor | where |
|---|---|---|---|
| time step | MIN of the local stable step | 1 double | `MeshImpl::max_time_step` |
| redo | MAX of 6 cause flags | 6 doubles (0 or 1) | `reduce_redo_flags` |
| stop on a signal | MAX of the caught-signal count | 1 int32 | `SignalHandler::CheckSignalFlags` |
| gravity-work fixer | SUM of 5 sums | 5 doubles | `MeshImpl::forward`; see below |
| cell count for the timing line | SUM to the root | 1 int64 | `MeshBlockImpl::finalize` |

: The collectives of one run. {#tbl-ch14-collectives}

Barriers sit at initialisation, around every combined output (@sec-ch14-netcdf, @sec-ch14-restart) and at
finalisation.

### Derivation

None. MIN and MAX of IEEE doubles do not depend on the order in which a backend combines them, so every rank gets
the same bits whatever the process count. A SUM does depend on the order (see Limits).

### Numerical method

**Time step.** `MeshImpl::max_time_step` takes the minimum of `local_max_time_step` over the local blocks on the
host, all-reduces it with MIN and returns $2^{-k}\,C\,\Delta t$, with $k$ the current redo count and $C$ the CFL
number ([`mesh.cpp:306-328`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L306-L328)). The single-block path does the same per block
(`MeshBlockImpl::max_time_step`, [`meshblock.cpp:510-529`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L510-L529)).

**Redo.** `MeshImpl::check_redo` first checks signals, then ORs the six local flags over the local blocks
(density or pressure floor hit, VIC dry clamp, the two limiter marks, saturation-adjustment failure, implicit solve
failure; see `local_redo_flags` in [`meshblock.cpp:1278-1286`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1278-L1286)). `reduce_redo_flags` all-reduces them
with MAX and packs the result into a cause bit mask ([`meshblock.cpp:1288-1300`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1288-L1300)).
Every block on every process then applies the same decision: a hit anywhere rolls back every block
(`MeshImpl::check_redo`, [`mesh.cpp:422-449`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L422-L449)). The redo itself is the subject of @sec-ch08.

**Signals.** SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGALRM set flags. `CheckSignalFlags` sums the local flags with the signals blocked,
all-reduces the count with MAX, and returns it; a non-zero value makes `check_redo` return $-1$ and the driver stop.
With no snapy process group it falls back to a registered external group
(`CheckSignalFlags`, [`signal_handler.cpp:64-86`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/utils/signal_handler.cpp#L64-L86)).

**Gravity-work fixer.**

::: {.callout-note title="Placeholder: waits for chengcli/snapy#303"}
The fixer's five-double SUM, its order of summation over local blocks and its effect on reproducibility are
described once #303 (the gravity-work change) has merged and the pin moves. At the pin the reduction is in
`MeshImpl::forward` (`MeshImpl::forward`, [`mesh.cpp:331-363`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L331-L363)).
:::

**Barriers.** `initialize` holds all processes at a barrier before the first step
([`meshblock.cpp:360-366`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L360-L366)); the combines of NetCDF and restart files each have
a barrier and a mirror barrier; `finalize` ends with a barrier and, if snapy owns the group, a shutdown
(`MeshImpl::finalize`, [`mesh.cpp:460-508`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L460-L508)).

| `test_cycle_diagnostics_parallel` | two processes with two blocks each: the cycle line aggregates the extrema found in the second local block of opposite processes | the test's own | `test_cycle_diagnostics_parallel.cpp` |

The redo check is `check_redo_is_one_decision_across_ranks` in [`test_check_redo_parallel.cpp:16-69`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/test_check_redo_parallel.cpp#L16-L69). No test
reduces a time step over ranks with different local steps, or delivers a signal to one rank only. Pass status at
the pin was not run for this chapter.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
- Signals are read only in `check_redo`, once per cycle. A rank that never reaches it (a hang elsewhere) never
  handles its signal, and the others wait in the collective; the comment in
  `CheckSignalFlags` [`signal_handler.cpp:64-68`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/utils/signal_handler.cpp#L64-L68) says so.
- Every collective is blocking and sits on the host, so each costs a device-to-host copy on GPU (@sec-ch14-gpu).
- The order dependence of the fixer SUM is left to the placeholder above (#303).
:::
